text: Forum comments let existing voting associates identify the most competent commenters and invite them to apply for membership by providing work for a grant, creating constant onboarding feedback effects that cannot exist in traditional centralized charitable organizations.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How Decentralized Autonomous Organizations Optimize Charitable Giving (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3981021

isBasedOn.name: How Decentralized Autonomous Organizations Optimize Charitable Giving

abstract: This helps increase the quality of talent that is onboarded into the CHARITYxDAO VA pool and creates constant onboarding feedback effects. Such feedback effects cannot exist in traditional centralized charitable organizations.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: DAO charities with open forums and grant based onboarding
